Flag outliers in a numeric vector

pv_outliers.Rd

"iqr" flags values outside [Q1 - k*IQR, Q3 + k*IQR]; "zscore" flags values more than z sample standard deviations from the mean. Missing values are never flagged. Like pv_profile(), the work runs in Python when available and in R otherwise, with identical results.

Usage

pv_outliers(
  x,
  method = c("iqr", "zscore"),
  k = 1.5,
  z = 3,
  engine = c("auto", "python", "r")
)

Arguments

x

A numeric vector.

method

"iqr" (default) or "zscore".

k

IQR multiplier (default 1.5).

z

Z-score threshold (default 3).

engine

"auto", "python", or "r".

Value

A logical vector the same length as x.

Examples

x <- c(rnorm(50), 12)
which(pv_outliers(x, engine = "r"))
#> [1]  9 13 20 21 50 51
